import_provenance.rule: every module must resolve inside ONE checkout — this module's own — because the shared .venv's editable install also exposes the main checkout's src

front_end.baseband_limit: B = 0.5 * min_r mean rps of the support (half the harmonic spacing)
front_end.baseline: median PSD over 0.5 B <= |f| <= B, subtracted before every shape metric
